data.text: Write exactly ten brief lines numbered 1 through 10 about counting. Do not use any tools.

content.text:
1. One apple is one count.
2. Two hands can count to ten.
3. Three groups make nine.
4. Four sides form a square.
5. Five fingers fit on one hand.
6. Six eggs fill one dozen by half.
7. Seven days make a week.
8. Eight makes a complete octave.
9. Nine comes before ten.
10. Ten is a round number.
